channel.title: SeaRates analysis
channel.description: Dated, source-linked analysis of ocean shipping costs, licences and delays.

item.title: Who Is the Cheapest Freight Forwarder? Why 62 Lists Cannot Say
item.description: Sixty-two ranking pages name a cheapest freight forwarder and three publish a method. What actually decides the bill is the scope of the quote, not the company.

item.title: How Not to Get Scammed Shipping a Car: 4 Free Checks, 9 Minutes
item.description: Deposit taken and booking resold, cloned site, hijacked invoice: the three patterns and the four free federal checks that catch them before the money moves.

item.title: How to Find a Reliable Freight Forwarder: 5 Checks
item.description: Five checks that return a fact rather than an adjective: the licence, the bond, the bill of lading issuer, the exclusions and the validity window. All five are free.

item.title: Biggest Freight Forwarder in the World: Two Answers, 2025 Data
item.description: By ocean containers moved the answer is Sinotrans. By revenue it is DSV. Both come from the same Armstrong & Associates 2025 tables, and they disagree by six places.

item.title: Are Freight Forwarders Worth It? When Self-Filing Wins
item.description: A forwarder buys slot access, filings and liability. Below roughly 50 containers a year the margin is real but small against what removing it adds back in work.

item.title: What Should a 20ft Container Cost to Ship in 2026?
item.description: Drewry assessed a 40ft box at $4,374 on 07/23/2026. A 20ft container is not half that, and the ocean line is 70% of what actually arrives on the invoice.

item.title: Who Is the No. 1 Container Company? MSC, at 21.4%
item.description: MSC holds 21.4% of the world fleet against Maersk at 13.8%. But 35.8% of MSC capacity is chartered, and alliances mean the line you booked may not be the line that carries it.

item.title: Cheapest Way to Ship From China to the USA in 2026
item.description: Under about 2 CBM, air or courier usually wins on total cost. Between 2 and 15, LCL. Above that, a full container. The Incoterm decides who pays what.

item.title: Disadvantages of LCL Shipping: Schedule, CFS, Liability
item.description: Consolidation adds a week at each end, a destination CFS charge of $15-165 per CBM that 0 of 23 ranking pages publish, and a shared box where one consignee’s hold delays yours.

item.title: Cheapest Way to Ship a Container: Where LCL Stops Winning
item.description: LCL bills per cubic metre or per revenue ton, whichever is higher. Past roughly 13-15 CBM a full container usually wins, and CFS charges move the crossover.

item.title: Average Cost of an International Move: $1,500-12,000 by Volume
item.description: Published bands run $1,500-3,000 for a shared container and $6,000-12,000 for a three-bedroom household. Volume and destination move it more than the mover does.

item.title: Why Shipping From China Costs What It Does in 2026
item.description: Drewry put a 40-foot container at $4,374 on 07/23/2026. Surcharges, tariffs and destination lines are what makes the delivered total feel unpredictable.

item.title: Shipping a 50 lb Package: You Are in the Wrong Market
item.description: A 50 lb parcel is a courier product, priced on chargeable weight by zone. Ocean freight starts around 2 CBM. Here is which market you are actually in.

item.title: How to Pick a Customs Broker: Licence, Permit, Bond
item.description: A customs broker licence is issued by CBP and is a different licence from the FMC ocean credential. Entry preparation runs $100-250. Here is what to check.

item.title: Cheapest Way to Move Internationally: Volume Decides
item.description: A shared container runs $1,500-3,000 against $6,000-12,000 for a three-bedroom household. Cutting volume before the survey is the only lever that moves both.

item.title: How to Negotiate With a Freight Forwarder: What Moves
item.description: The federal fees are fixed and the ocean rate is bought, not set. What is negotiable is the handling schedule, the free time and the scope — and scope is worth the most.

item.title: Top US Freight Forwarders: 2 of 9 Are US-Based
item.description: Of the nine forwarders in the Armstrong 2025 ocean and revenue tables, two are US-based: C.H. Robinson and Expeditors. The rest lead from Europe and Asia.

item.title: Is This Freight Forwarder Legit? The Check 2 of 245 Pages Show
item.description: The federal register answers it in about two minutes. Of 245 ranking pages measured, 2 show an OTI number and 4 point the reader at the database.

item.title: How Is LCL Calculated? Weight or Measure, Higher Wins
item.description: LCL bills per cubic metre or per revenue ton, whichever is higher. Work the volume, work the weight, take the larger, then add the charges that do not scale.

item.title: RoRo Shipping Cost 2026: $900-2,500 and What Is Not Inside
item.description: Published RoRo bands run $900-2,500 per car against $3,000-5,500 for a sole-use container, read 07/25-26/2026. Destination charges sit outside both.

item.title: Customs Broker Cost: $100-250 an Entry, and the Fees Around It
item.description: Brokerage entry runs $100-250 across 299 measured pages. ISF is billed separately at $35-100, and the federal fees are calculable to the cent.

item.title: 40ft Container Shipping Cost: $4,374 Index, July 2026
item.description: Drewry assessed a 40ft box at $4,374 on 07/23/2026, down 4% on the week. That is a composite across many shippers, and it is about 70% of what the invoice comes to.

item.title: Is FedEx a Freight Forwarder? Three Markets, One Word
item.description: Large integrators run parcel networks and forwarding arms under one brand. What decides your liability is which entity issues the bill of lading, not the logo.

item.title: NVOCC vs Freight Forwarder: One Is an Agent, One Is a Carrier
item.description: A freight forwarder acts as your agent. An NVOCC issues its own bill of lading and takes on carrier liability. Same federal licence family, different bond, different claim.

item.title: How to Reduce Container Shipping Costs: 6 Real Levers
item.description: The ocean line is 70% of an FCL total and the least negotiable part of it. Six levers that move real money, ranked by how much they actually move.

item.title: Common Freight Mistakes: What 2,001 Pages Never Warn
item.description: Comparing quotes of different scopes, assuming free time, treating an index as a price, and skipping the licence check — ranked by what each one costs.

item.title: Can You Negotiate Demurrage? Check the Invoice First
item.description: Before negotiating, check the invoice against the four tests in the FMC billing rule. An invoice missing a required element carries no obligation to pay.

item.title: Do Cars Get Damaged in Shipping? Cover, GA, Evidence
item.description: Marine cover runs 1.5-2.5% of declared value and does not include General Average. The condition report at handover is what decides a claim either way.

item.title: Demurrage Cost Per Day 2026: $75-300 and It Escalates
item.description: Published US demurrage runs $75-300 per container per day and steps up in tiers. Free time is typically 3 to 7 days, and detention is a separate invoice.
